assignment: R4 — Booking Channels and Confirmation Semantics
summary: Production booking state must be separate from user authorization and notification state.
Waitlist membership, routing/form submission, availability observations, slot holds and sent requests are not confirmed appointments.
Real systems expose pending vs accepted states; reschedule can be cancellation plus creation; email confirmation can lag the canonical booking record.
Transaction adapter should persist operation IDs/idempotency keys, reconcile timeouts before retry, respect external versions, and support an explicit UNKNOWN_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED state.
Current beta READY_FOR_TRANSACTION_ADAPTER should remain an authorization handoff, not be renamed BOOKED/CONFIRMED.
cross_lane_dependencies: R3 provider discovery should expose booking-channel provenance and capabilities.
R10 integration architecture should consume the proposed transaction state model, idempotency/reconciliation requirements and reschedule saga semantics.
R6 voice workflow should define evidence capture for phone-confirmed bookings and ambiguous verbal requests.
authority_note: Evidence/proposal only. No accepted-state mutation performed.
